ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this"Agreement")is made as of the 15th day of June,2016byandbetween326 GRAND REALTY INC.,a NewYork Corporation having an address at 11 East Broadway, Suite 7A, New York, New York 10038 ("324 Grand Owner"); and LUDLOW 65 REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address of c/o Ascot Properties, 46 Trinity Place, 2" Floor, New York, New York 10006 ("65 Ludlow Owner"); each individually, a "Party,” and collectively, the "Parties." WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,324 Grand Owner is the owner of certain land with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street address 324 Grand Street,designated as Lot 28in Block 408on the TaxMap of the City of New York, County of New York, State of New York (the "Tax Map"), as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein referred to as the "324 Land." said buildings and improvements, and any future buildings or improvements, and/or any replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement being herein referred to as the "324 Building."and the 324 Land and the 324 Building being herein collectively called the "324 Premises"); WHEREAS, 324Grand Owner is the owner of certain land with thebuildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally identified as a portion of Tax Lot 21 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit C provisions of this Agreement being referred to herein as the "Lot 21 Building"; collectively, the Lot 21 Parcel and the Lot 21 Building shall be referred to herein as the “Lot 21 Premises,”and together the 324 Land and the Lot 21 Parcel shall be referred to herein as the “Subject Land," the Lot 21 Building and the 324 Building shall be referred to herein as the “Subject Building.,” and the Subject Land and the Subject Building being herein collectively referred to as the “Subject Premises"); WHEREAS, 65 Ludlow Owner is the owner of certain land with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street address 65 Ludlow Street, New York, New York, designated as a portion of Lot 21 in Block 408 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein called the "65 Land" and said buildings and improvements being herein referred to as the "65 Building" and the 65 Land and 65 Building being collectively WHEREAS, the 65 Building is an existing five (5) story mixed commercial and residential tenement building: WHEREAS,68 Orchard LLC,a New York limited liability company with an address at 95 Delancey Street, New York, NY, 10002, was formerly the owner of the 324 Premises, the Lot 21 Premises, and the 65 Premises;
